gameplay.city_scope: Only Saltwater-local businesses and premises are generated; no second city or off-map playable territory is created.
gameplay.location_resolution: Every establishment links to a canonical property, building, premises, unit and address.
gameplay.population_isolation: Businesses, establishments and staffing bands do not create person records or count toward population.
gameplay.registry_invariant: At least 10,000 distinct local business identities.
